text: Follow-up hardening: BuildOptions now exposes validation through buildEither, so non-finite ImputeConstant returns DesignError.InvalidSchema instead of throwing during option construction. EventModelBuilderParitySuite passes 16/16 on JVM and 16/16 on Scala.js; git diff --check is clean. P2.2 remains open for centering/orthogonalization and broader policy/scenario criteria.
